verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents a first-party REST API that lets users manage data and features without the UI, which is a headless programmatic way to drive the product for automation. There is no evidence of a CLI, CI integration guidance or a machine-readable spec, and probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404. Missing for 10: official CLI or CI tooling, documented headless/CI workflows, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of API-driven automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The REST API lets you manage data and features in sevdesk and connect external services to sevdesk.
